comment: Catalog of Electron apps the patcher knows how to locate on Windows. Add your own entries here - see README. 'type':'asar' apps ship a packed resources/app.asar (extract/inject/repack). 'type':'dir' apps ship an unpacked resources/app/ folder (inject in place). 'injectMode':'external' (optional, default 'inline') writes the JS payload to a sidecar file and references it via <script src> - required for apps with a strict CSP (e.g. VS Code) that blocks inline scripts.

apps.name: Claude Desktop
apps.notes: Anthropic Claude Desktop. Installs per-version under app-<ver>\; updates frequently, so re-run after each update.

apps.name: Visual Studio Code
apps.notes: VS Code has a strict CSP (no 'unsafe-inline' for script-src), so we must inject as an external <script src> sidecar file. Re-run after VS Code updates.

apps.name: VS Code Insiders
apps.notes: VS Code Insiders. Versioned hash subfolders; patcher targets the newest. Insiders updates ~daily, overwriting the patch - re-run after updates.

apps.name: Cursor
apps.notes: Cursor is VS Code-based; same unpacked layout and strict CSP. Re-run after updates.

apps.name: ChatGPT Desktop
apps.notes: OpenAI ChatGPT desktop app. Path varies by installer; experimental.

apps.name: Slack
apps.notes: Slack installs per-version under app-<ver>\. Experimental - Slack's renderer is heavily bundled.

apps.name: Discord
apps.notes: EXPERIMENTAL + RISKY. Discord's app.asar is a thin loader and patching the client may conflict with its self-update and is discouraged by Discord. Use at your own risk.
